request: Publish the synthetic public-sector Supply-Chain Risk Management (SCRM) fixture to Tableau as 6 independent passthrough published data sources (one per table: risk_snapshots, suppliers, risk_registry, components, contracts, findings). NO joins and NO transforms: the downstream SCRM risk-brief and triage agents query each table on its own LUID via the Tableau MCP and must never fan the bridges/history out, so each table stays a separate 1:1 source and keeps its grain. The suppliers source is the FILTERED csv with composite_risk_pct removed (a circular validation roll-up that would let the agent read a planted effect off a precomputed column). The scrm_redteam_injection.csv fixture is NOT published. All data is SYNTHETIC. Target the usfederaldemos Prep Agent demo collection.

sources.name: SCRM Risk Snapshots
sources.description: SYNTHETIC public-sector SCRM fixture: one row per supplier x KRI x month (40 x 7 x 18). The Pulse/alert source. Carries risk_score (0-100, higher=worse), RAG band, threshold, month-over-month delta, and the materialized alert layer (alert_flag / alert_reason firing on change: breach / warning / escalation / sustained-worsening). Advisory demo data only.

sources.name: SCRM Suppliers
sources.description: SYNTHETIC public-sector SCRM fixture: supplier dimension (sector, acquisition portfolio + portfolio_owner_user, country_of_ownership, ownership_type, foci_flag, criticality, small_business, established_year, contract_count, performance_archetype). composite_risk_pct is intentionally EXCLUDED (a circular validation roll-up). Advisory demo data only.

sources.name: SCRM Risk Registry
sources.description: SYNTHETIC public-sector SCRM fixture: the 7 KRI definitions (NIST SP 800-161 / FASCSA aligned) with threshold, direction, yellow band, composite weight, and the owning Slack channel + analyst function that route a role-scoped alert. Advisory demo data only.

sources.name: SCRM Components
sources.description: SYNTHETIC public-sector SCRM fixture: parts & provenance (one row per component). country_of_origin, section_889_category, single_source_flag, has_sbom, criticality. Kept as its own source so the analysis agent never fans it into snapshots. Advisory demo data only.

sources.name: SCRM Contracts
sources.description: SYNTHETIC public-sector SCRM fixture: program/contract exposure (one row per contract). program, agency, contract_type, naics, value/obligated, period of performance, status. Answers which programs are exposed if a supplier is compromised. Advisory demo data only.

sources.name: SCRM Findings
sources.description: SYNTHETIC public-sector SCRM fixture: the qualitative so-what layer (one row per open risk finding), joins to snapshots on supplier_key + risk_category. root_cause, mitigation_goal, progress_note, source, owner_function, owning_channel, data_quality_flag. Free-text notes are SANITIZED (the raw prompt-injection fixture is held out and NOT published). Advisory demo data only.

outputs.description: SYNTHETIC / ADVISORY DEMO DATA. One row per supplier x KRI x month for the public-sector SCRM demo; the Pulse/alert source (risk_score 0-100, RAG, alert_flag / alert_reason).
